title: A failed computation leaves no case-insensitive key behind
summary: A failed computation now leaves size, iteration and case-insensitive membership in agreement. A successful retry keeps its own KEY spelling.

change.description: LinkedCaseInsensitiveMap defers key registration until a mapping function produces a non-null value. Membership, iteration and stored spelling should then agree.

notes: An existing null-valued mapping retained its original spelling on both revisions. The throwing function is checked by exception identity.
